description: React frontend source code for RoadRescue MVP UI, including routing, user authentication, location handling, notifications, and mechanic portal features.

methods.name: generateId
methods.description: Generates a lightweight unique id for client-only request storage, not cryptographically secure.

methods.name: formatLatLng
methods.description: Formats latitude and longitude into a string with 6 decimal places.

methods.name: formatMoney
methods.description: Formats a number as USD currency string.

methods.name: geocodeAddress
methods.description: Uses OpenStreetMap Nominatim API to geocode an address into lat/lon and display name.

methods.name: parseLatLng
methods.description: Parses a 'lat,lng' string into numeric coordinates, accepting various formats.

methods.name: isAuthenticated
methods.description: Checks if a user session exists in localStorage.

methods.name: tryNotify
methods.description: Requests browser notification permission and displays notifications.

methods.description: Returns current browser notification permission state.

methods.name: saveNotifiedStatusMap

methods.name: notifyOnceForStatus

methods.name: loadRequests

methods.name: saveRequests
methods.description: Saves request data to localStorage.

methods.name: saveAuthUser
methods.description: Saves authenticated user info to localStorage.

methods.name: loadMechanicSession
methods.description: Loads mechanic session info from localStorage.

methods.name: saveMechanicSession
methods.description: Saves mechanic session info to localStorage.

methods.name: clearMechanicSession
methods.description: Removes mechanic session info from localStorage.

methods.name: loadMechanics

methods.name: saveMechanics
